appraisal_events.evidence: en reconnaissant la princesse, tous ceux qui cherchaient à savoir qui était dans la salle sentaient se relever dans leur cœur le trône légitime de la beauté... c'était la forme d'un corps et d'un visage délicieux que la princesse apposait à l'angle de sa loge, montrant par là que la beauté peut être la plus noble des signatures
appraisal_events.explanation: Against a neighbor's dismissive mockery of her title and her display of pearls, the narrator and the wider theatre audience recognize the princess as possessing an authentic, legitimate beauty that outranks other titled women identified only by ugly, conventional features.

appraisal_events.evidence: Personne n'excitait en moi autant d'envie que lui, à cause de l'habitude qu'il avait l'air d'avoir de cette baignoire et de l'indifférence avec laquelle il laissait la princesse lui tendre des bonbons; elle jetait alors sur lui un regard de ses beaux yeux...
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles out Palancy as an object of envy because his casual familiarity with the princess's box and his indifferent acceptance of her personally offered sweets mark him as intimately, visibly favored by her.

status_effects.explanation: Her beauty is publicly and collectively recognized by the theatre's onlookers as the true mark of her rank, overriding a bystander's petty mockery of her title and taste.
His visible, casual intimacy with the princess in her box, and the personal attention she gives him, mark him as locally privileged in a way the envious narrator registers.
